cleanup.mdd: Paint over what bothers you and it goes.
cleanup.aria.canvas: Photo — arrow keys move, space paints
cleanup.status.ready: Paint what to erase (drag, or focus and use the keyboard)
cleanup.status.badImage: Could not read that as an image
cleanup.status.keys: Arrows move, space paints · Shift for big steps · + - for brush size
cleanup.status.nothingPainted: Nothing painted — paint what to erase first
cleanup.status.done: Covered {n} pixels with the surrounding colours
cleanup.status.cleared: Cleared the painting (the photo is untouched)
cleanup.note.keys: Drag to paint, or click the photo to focus it and paint with arrows + space.
cleanup.note.limits: This covers with surrounding colour — it does not invent what was behind. Things sitting on continuous backgrounds (wires, passers-by, watermarks, dust on sky, wall or grass) disappear cleanly; erasing the middle of a pattern shows. The wider you paint, the higher the depth needs to be.
